detail: Scalar P13/P30 argument access and Float64 normalization are inside; geometric point selection/derivation happened earlier.

Independent replay and residual solution path.
Stage0 classification and production attempt_class both occur before evaluate_physical! returns.
Benchmark binding_mechanism is computed after the point timer; production search-level binding analysis remains inside the full run timer.
Logical and attempt counters mutate inside evaluate_physical!.
In-memory NamedTuple construction and push are included.
Per-attempt timestamp/search/phase/initialization provenance fields are captured inside; file hashing is outside.
Accepted-neighbor voltage copy/push is included; nearest-neighbor search occurs only after first-attempt nonconvergence.
Numerically accepted neighbor storage is inside the point timer; production safe/violating search-vector storage is outside the point wrapper but inside the production run.
The bounded benchmark does not run a ray/axis sweep.
The bounded benchmark uses committed points and creates no adaptive plan.
Benchmark timing-row merge and CSV writes are outside. Production final CSVs are after finished_at; in-memory attempt rows are a separate inside-timer item. No DataFrame is used.
Production writes 1,794 current-work checkpoints and 32 completed-timestamp checkpoints; the benchmark writes none.
Benchmark package hashes are after all timings. Production preregistration/provenance hashes are inside run wall, while final output-manifest hashing is after finished_at.
